notes: Three branches of «ح»: the first two meet at «كلاهما عن هشام», the third at «قالا، جميعا حدثنا قتادة»; the names after the last «ح» (قتادة, أنس) are the shared tail
«قال سمعت أبي» makes the father a bare relation who narrates with Mu'tamir (both «قالا»)
«بهذه القصة» is a back-reference to the story, not to the chain, and is left out
